summary: Full backend + frontend testing of MWCREW BMW registration site. All 13 pytest backend tests pass (count, admin auth, registration CRUD, validation, 25-place limit enforcement with 26th -> 409). Frontend home renders hero (MWCREW, 19 Juillet, Lac de l'Eau d'Heure), counter, edition-1/edition-2 gallery images and registration form. Successful registration shows success state with place number and counter updates from 25 -> 24. Empty form submission is correctly prevented (no success state shown). Admin /admin: wrong password rejected, correct password (mwcrew2025) opens dashboard with table, logout returns to login form. Test data cleaned up after run.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py: ADMIN_TOKEN has a default literal which is overridden by .env (good). Consider hashing/rotating token per session in future iterations.
Admin.jsx uses localStorage for token — acceptable for low-stakes admin, but a logged-out user can still read token via XSS; fine for this scope.
Photo cap 5MB on FE, 7M base64 chars on BE: aligned. OK.
Empty interet pattern validates strictly to one of 4 values via Pydantic regex — good.
All required interactive elements have data-testid — strong testability.
seed_data_creation: All TEST_ prefixed registrations created during tests were cleaned up via DELETE endpoint at end of run. Registrations collection should be empty (or contain only pre-existing entries).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Use /app/backend/tests/test_mwcrew.py as regression suite. The 'test_sold_out_limit' test fills all 25 places to verify 26th returns 409, then cleans up. If running back-to-back, ensure cleanup completed. Admin token returned by login is a static value defined in backend/.env (ADMIN_TOKEN).
